answer.reason: Hebron is the place where Sarah was buried, where Caleb received his inheritance, and where David was anointed king over Judah and then over all Israel.

clauses.english: was where Abraham buried Sarah in the cave of Machpelah
clauses.quote: Abraham buried Sarah his wife in the cave of the field of Machpelah

clauses.english: was given to Caleb for an inheritance
clauses.quote: gave unto Caleb the son of Jephunneh Hebron for an inheritance

clauses.english: was where the men of Judah anointed David king
clauses.quote: there they anointed David king over the house of Judah

clauses.english: was where the elders of Israel anointed David king over all Israel
clauses.quote: they anointed David king over Israel

doubts: JOS 15:54 and JOS 19:28 are list verses, and JOS 19:28 seems to concern another Hebron in Asher, so both were left out.
Joshua's destruction of Hebron (JOS 10:36-37) was left out to keep the line short.
